method: Read-only source and existing test-case coverage inspection. No additional engine execution, installation, device test or full-check completion is claimed by this review.

areas.name: read/reconcile
checks: Persistent read returns metadata-only branded rows; no generation/tool process or directory adoption.
Restored rows remain preserved and never enter ownedOutputs. Refresh reconciles previous-session rows while active admitted jobs retain their own object.
Removed or changed restored rows revoke builds/latest selection after an explicit idle refresh; current in-memory creation receipts are kept.
areas.conclusion: No additional blocking finding in this declared reconciliation boundary.

areas.name: scope/inspect
checks: Small readable author workspace identity is compared without fetching author bodies/assets; offline frozen access remains supported.
Inspect performs namespace/project identity and manifest SHA guard, complete frozen regeneration/inventory verification, then identity guard again.
Source workspace/scene/path, requested build/snapshot and exact manifest hash are bound; inspection cannot select runtime implicitly.
areas.conclusion: No additional blocking finding in the explicit inspection boundary.

areas.name: selection
checks: Selection verifies the whole project and frozen plan before producing control targets or granting runtime entry.
Epoch plus captured latestBuild/job references reject older delayed completion after newer selection or new job.
Closed/active/probe status and same projects-map object are rechecked after awaits before publishing latestBuild.
areas.conclusion: Existing delayed-selection, close and new-build cases cover the relevant owner transitions; no additional blocking finding.

areas.name: run/suite
checks: Both run and suite jobs call the shared catalog-or-current-root guard before invoking the frozen executor.
Restored runtime entries contain no deletion ledger; runtime operations still use the frozen backend and fresh tool verification.
Suite admission detaches member definitions, checks frozen IDs, then rechecks close/busy and builds-map reference before acquiring its slot.
areas.conclusion: No additional blocking finding in admitted frozen execution ownership. This review does not certify actual engine behavior.

areas.name: close
checks: Close marks the service closed and aborts active job/probe before waiting.
Close waits active/probe, pending catalog read and tracked caseOperations, including delayed inspect/select.
Pending select checks closed before publishing ownership; status checks closed after asynchronous discovery.
areas.conclusion: No additional blocking finding in service close/selection completion.

areas.name: retention
checks: Only current creating-host ledger objects enter the automatic retention queue.
Quarantine movement persists its known physical identity and new relative path; modified/extra/session outputs are preserved.
Catalog remove mutates only the index and never removes a project; failed index updates produce a visible diagnostic.
areas.conclusion: Persistent catalog remains separate from the automatic deletion authority.

resolvedFinding.description: Temporary cleanup failure previously skipped release and left an owned lock blocking subsequent writes.
resolvedFinding.fix: Nested finally guarantees owner-guarded lock release; missing temporary path is ignored and foreign temporary inode/link is preserved.

limitations: Old outputs never registered by the creating host are not scanned or automatically adopted. CLI-created outputs remain accessible through explicit CLI inspection only.
The catalog is bounded to 256 records and 1 MiB. Reaching a limit reports a diagnostic; no older record is silently evicted.
The scope binds the cache namespace to the author root path and backend. Moving author/output paths or replacing physical identities does not automatically adopt previous projects.
Only successful outputs are persisted in this catalog. Failed/partial outputs retain current-session protection and diagnostics; they do not gain cross-session recovery records.
Restored projects are preserved and are never assigned a fresh deletion receipt, even after explicit runtime selection.
Unknown stale locks are not automatically removed. Persistent index corruption is not silently repaired or overwritten.
conclusion: The confirmed catalog lock-release issue is repaired and independently reproduced as fixed. No additional unresolved blocking finding was identified in the reviewed frozen service integration. Full application/prepared/browser and actual backend evidence remains the responsibility of the separately recorded root validation.
